description:
Review uncommitted vault changes, then stage and commit them.

Subcommands:
  review [--max-file-lines N] [--max-lines N] — show everything changed since the last commit; read-only
  save --message SUBJECT [--body TEXT] [--dry-run] — stage every change in the vault and commit it

Flags:
  review: --max-file-lines max diff lines shown per file, default 150; --max-lines max lines of output overall, default 3000.
  save: --message is required and must be a single non-empty line; --body carries multi-line detail; --dry-run reports what would be staged and committed and changes nothing.

Examples:
  ["review"]
  ["save", "--message", "Log SGB meeting and June hours", "--body", "Added meeting note, flushed buffer, logged 3h."]
  ["save", "--message", "Flush buffer", "--dry-run"]

Notes:
  Run `review` first and write the message from what it actually shows; never commit with a guessed summary.
  `save` only ever adds a commit — it never amends, rebases, resets, checks out or pushes.
  Exit 1 on: a multi-line or empty --message, a vault that is not the root of its git repository, or a failing git call.
